construct: baseline harness behavior without v0.4 ablation components enabled

input.description: Run the shared ablation benchmark manifest with ToolGuard, ContextBuilder, Signal Pipeline, and Hashline disabled.
setup: Do not run agentic trials in the first milestone; validate manifest and metric extraction shape

expectedBehavior: The runner can construct the baseline configuration and produce comparable metric placeholders without relying on agent-authored summaries.
passCondition: manifest_valid == true AND config == 'baseline' AND metric_schema_valid == true
failureImplication: Ablation comparison has no trustworthy baseline.
relatedPaper: AHE: component effects can be non-additive, so baseline must be preserved.
regressionRisk: Baseline accidentally includes a v0.4 component and invalidates deltas.
